title: FixturePoolApiSDK Tool Definitions
description: LLM tool calling bindings for fixture-pool-api API

tools.name: account.pool.pick
tools.title: Account pool: pick

mcp.name: Account pool: pick
mcp.description: Picks a member to run work on, a read of the table as a whole that writes nothing: of the members match keeps, leaving out those exclude names, the first by order of the open members prefer keeps, then of its near ones, then of the other open and near ones. A member counts as out while its table's Capacity has no room for it. With none it answers member null and until, the soonest time a member match keeps may be back, so a caller waits on a deadline of its own. It reads at most 2000 members.

tools.description: Picks a member to run work on, a read of the table as a whole that writes nothing: of the members match keeps, leaving out those exclude names, the first by order of the open members prefer keeps, then of its near ones, then of the other open and near ones. exclude.description: The keys of the members the caller tried in this attempt, which pick leaves out.

match.description: The members to pick among, by the values own fields of the table hold, a null member absent; every member when absent.

prefer.description: The members to try first, by the values own fields of the table hold, a null member absent; every member when absent.

tools.name: account.pool.markOut
tools.title: Account pool: mark out

mcp.name: Account pool: mark out
mcp.description: Puts the member out until until, or outForMs from now when it names none, for reason: what a caller a provider refused tells the pool. An out member keeps the later of its outUntil and the new one and takes the new reason, and a call that moves neither is answered unchanged. Arms the member's recheck at its outUntil. Needs permission.

tools.description: Puts the member out until until, or outForMs from now when it names none, for reason: what a caller a provider refused tells the pool. An out member keeps the later of its outUntil and the new one and takes the new reason, and a call that moves neither is answered unchanged. Arms the member's recheck at its outUntil. Needs permission.

id.description: The key of the Account row the operation runs on.

reason.description: Why it is out: the provider's word, or the caller's.

until.description: Until when the member is out, in epoch milliseconds, as the provider named it; outForMs from now when absent, and now for a time already past.

tools.name: account.pool.reportRoom
tools.title: Account pool: report room

mcp.name: Account pool: report room
mcp.description: Records a check of the member at its provider, made now. With room it opens an out member whose outUntil has come, near when near says so, and keeps an open or near one open or near as near says; a check with room before an out member's outUntil records checkedAt alone. With no room the member is out until the later of its outUntil and resetsAt, or outForMs from now when the check names no time, and its recheck is armed then, or recheckAfterMs from now when that is later. Needs permission.

tools.description: Records a check of the member at its provider, made now. With room it opens an out member whose outUntil has come, near when near says so, and keeps an open or near one open or near as near says; a check with room before an out member's outUntil records checkedAt alone. With no room the member is out until the later of its outUntil and resetsAt, or outForMs from now when the check names no time, and its recheck is armed then, or recheckAfterMs from now when that is later. Needs permission.

id.description: The key of the Account row the operation runs on.

near.description: With room: whether the member is near its limit, which pick tries after the open members. Read only with room.

reason.description: With no room: why, the provider's word; when absent, the member's reason when it was out already, else no room. Read only without room.

resetsAt.description: With no room: when the provider names the member's room back, in epoch milliseconds. Read only without room.

room.description: Whether the provider has room for the member now.

tools.name: account.budget.checkReserve
tools.title: Account budget: check reserve

mcp.name: Account budget: check reserve
mcp.description: Whether reserve with the same parameters would fit now, here and in every enclosing scope, after the reservations of a lease that is no longer active are settled, as reserve settles them; it changes nothing and does not ask for a lease. Queue copies its answer so that a claim that cannot fit is not tried.

tools.description: Whether reserve with the same parameters would fit now, here and in every enclosing scope, after the reservations of a lease that is no longer active are settled, as reserve settles them; it changes nothing and does not ask for a lease. Queue copies its answer so that a claim that cannot fit is not tried.

amount.description: How much of the meter; its configured reservation when absent. Needs meter.

id.description: The key of the Account row the operation runs on.

meter.description: The meter; every meter with a configured reservation when absent.

tools.name: account.budget.observe
tools.title: Account budget: observe

mcp.name: Account budget: observe
mcp.description: Records the usage of a meter a provider reports, in place of what the meter counts until resetsAt (until the meter's next reset without it, and until the next observe for a meter with no reset): the meter's used is the figure given, usage recorded after it adds to it, and limit, when given, is the meter's limit while it holds. Nothing passes up to an enclosing scope. Needs observePermission. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

tools.description: Records the usage of a meter a provider reports, in place of what the meter counts until resetsAt (until the meter's next reset without it, and until the next observe for a meter with no reset): the meter's used is the figure given, usage recorded after it adds to it, and limit, when given, is the meter's limit while it holds. Nothing passes up to an enclosing scope. Needs observePermission. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

id.description: The key of the Account row the operation runs on.

limit.description: The limit the provider holds the row to, while the observation holds; the meter's own when absent.

resetsAt.description: When the provider's count starts again, in epoch milliseconds: the observation lapses then.

used.description: What the provider counts as used.

tools.name: account.budget.recordUsage
tools.title: Account budget: record usage

mcp.name: Account budget: record usage
mcp.description: Records usage of a meter, which is never refused. The part of it the instance's own reservation covers is released, here and in every enclosing scope, and the usage counts in each of them. Reports every instance of the chain whose usage is over its limit after it, moves the status of each whose config gives escalate, and sends onExceeded's directive to the holder of the active lease once per meter per lease.

tools.description: Records usage of a meter, which is never refused. Reports every instance of the chain whose usage is over its limit after it, moves the status of each whose config gives escalate, and sends onExceeded's directive to the holder of the active lease once per meter per lease.

id.description: The key of the Account row the operation runs on.

tools.name: account.budget.recordUsageFor
tools.title: Account budget: record usage for

mcp.name: Account budget: record usage for
mcp.description: Counts usage of a meter by an instance whose scope link points here, releases the part of what this instance holds for it that its own reservation covered, never more than that one no longer holds, and passes both on up this instance's own scope. Never refused for the amount.

tools.description: Counts usage of a meter by an instance whose scope link points here, releases the part of what this instance holds for it that its own reservation covered, never more than that one no longer holds, and passes both on up this instance's own scope. Never refused for the amount.

released.description: How much of its reservation the usage drew down.

schema.description: The schema of the instance inside this scope.

tools.name: account.budget.reserve
tools.title: Account budget: reserve

mcp.name: Account budget: reserve
mcp.description: Reserves an amount of one meter, or of every meter the config gives a reservation, for the instance and every enclosing scope. Refused when the instance or an enclosing scope cannot fit it, and then nothing is reserved anywhere. On a type that composes Lease it needs an active lease, and the reservation is settled when that lease ends.

tools.description: Reserves an amount of one meter, or of every meter the config gives a reservation, for the instance and every enclosing scope. Refused when the instance or an enclosing scope cannot fit it, and then nothing is reserved anywhere. On a type that composes Lease it needs an active lease, and the reservation is settled when that lease ends.

amount.description: How much to reserve of the meter; its configured reservation when absent. Needs meter.

id.description: The key of the Account row the operation runs on.

meter.description: The meter; every meter with a configured reservation when absent.

tools.name: account.budget.reserveFor
tools.title: Account budget: reserve for

mcp.name: Account budget: reserve for
mcp.description: Holds an amount of a meter for an instance whose scope link points here, as that instance's reserve does, and passes it on up this instance's own scope. Refused when the amount does not fit, when that instance does not draw the meter from here, and beyond what it has reserved and this instance does not hold for it yet.

tools.description: Holds an amount of a meter for an instance whose scope link points here, as that instance's reserve does, and passes it on up this instance's own scope. Refused when the amount does not fit, when that instance does not draw the meter from here, and beyond what it has reserved and this instance does not hold for it yet.

schema.description: The schema of the instance inside this scope.

tools.name: account.budget.setLimit
tools.title: Account budget: set limit

mcp.name: Account budget: set limit
mcp.description: Sets a meter's limit on the instance, raising or lowering it; through limitField when the meter has one. Needs limitPermission, and is refused when the config names none, and below what the instance has used and reserved.

tools.description: Sets a meter's limit on the instance, raising or lowering it; through limitField when the meter has one. Needs limitPermission, and is refused when the config names none, and below what the instance has used and reserved.

tools.title: Account budget: settle

mcp.name: Account budget: settle
mcp.description: Releases the instance's own reservation of one meter, or of every meter, here and in every enclosing scope.

tools.description: Releases the instance's own reservation of one meter, or of every meter, here and in every enclosing scope.

meter.description: The meter; every meter when absent.

mcp.name: Account budget: settle for
mcp.description: Releases up to an amount of what this instance holds of a meter for another, never more than that one no longer holds itself, and passes the release on up this instance's own scope.
